Let's try to brainstorm a way to annotate some of our DEGs.


let's start with extracting protein sequences from genes of interest

```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# 1. Load your master protein/transcript FASTA
all_sequences <- readAAStringSet("path/to/full_predicted_orfs.faa") 
# (Use readDNAStringSet if uploading nucleotide sequences)

# 2. Define your vector of target DEGs (e.g., genes with |logFC| > 1)
target_gene_ids <- rownames(top_degs)

# 3. Filter sequences matching your target IDs
selected_sequences <- all_sequences[names(all_sequences) %in% target_gene_ids]

# 4. Save the subset to a new FASTA file
writeXStringSet(selected_sequences, "results/new-results/top_DEGs_for_eggnog.fasta")
```
